g.text: Weeks 4-5 — Add a normal task (main success scenario)
Precondition: main.js has injected the dependencies;
stored tasks are loaded, callbacks are bound,
and controller.start() has rendered the page.
type "Buy milk" and click Add Task
create normal task record and append to tasks
bind Done / Delete to supplied action callbacks
flash new row; schedule removal; update title
new task is visible in To do
Success: the task is saved and displayed.
Rejected short input is a separate scenario:
service returns null, no save or redraw occurs.
